item.title: Charles Wade urges ‘holy behavior’
item.description: At the T.B. Maston Foundation Awards Dinner, Charles Wade called believers to embody both righteous living and social justice. Charles and Rosemary Wade and Skye Perryman were recognized for their work in Christian ethics.

item.title: Wayne Bray 2027 Pastors’ Conference president nominee
item.description: Florida pastor Ted Traylor announced March 3 his intention to nominate South Carolina pastor Wayne Bray to serve as president of the 2027 Southern Baptist Convention Pastors’ Conference in Indianapolis.
